summary: The diagnostics toggle helper is documented and described in-source as bounded, but runToggleEvidence(lab, cycles) accepts any positive integer with no upper bound. A caller can therefore request an arbitrarily long Studio evidence sweep even though the quality contract and docs define a 20-cycle bounded proof. Primary/test work should either cap the optional cycle override to an explicitly documented diagnostic maximum (with boundary regression) or document why an unbounded manual override is intentionally safe; do not infer a new cap silently.
evidence: src/server/PhysicsLab/PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics.luau sets cycleCount = cycles or 20 and only asserts positive integral input before for cycle = 1, cycleCount do.
The same source comments that the evidence sweep is intentionally bounded.
Docs/PHYSICS_LAB_DIAGNOSTICS.md names the path Source-owned bounded toggle sweep and defines the accepted proof as twenty cycles with checkpoints 1/5/10/20.
